prompt: Create a polished 2D CHARACTER DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for Memory Forge, a Korean subculture fantasy RPG about a harbor city of memories and brass clockwork. Very wide 2:1 landscape sheet, target 2048 x 1024. Exactly one character shown in three full-body views: front, three-quarter, and back, evenly spaced, same scale, matching face, hairstyle, clothing and equipment. Include complete head and boots in every view with clear margins. Warm off-white plain background, no scenery. Crisp elegant illustrated line work, refined clean cel shading and soft painted light, attractive expressive Korean game character design, sophisticated restrained palette, readable silhouettes. Never photorealistic or 3D. This is a FIRST DESIGN CANDIDATE, not an already approved character. No words, labels, logo, watermark, frames or UI. Consistency and correct signature equipment matter more than ornamental detail. SERA, exactly age 24, a clearly adult tall slender woman. Long silver-white hair tied in a LOW ponytail, natural amber eyes with extremely subtle tiny clock-hand iris markings visible only on close inspection. The iris pattern must not turn into glowing eyewear, a star across the eyelids or face paint. Calm confidence and a hint of dry humor. Form-fitting BLACK BODYSUIT beneath an OPEN NAVY LONG COAT with elegant BRASS GEAR TRIM, thigh holster and FINGERLESS gloves. An amber hair clip echoes brass scope fittings. Keep an elegant coherent black/navy/brass silhouette and naturally adult proportions. Her mandatory signature weapon is a LONG-RANGE SNIPER RIFLE, long barrel, stock, realistic hand grips and scope, with a clearly visible TRANSPARENT HOURGLASS CHAMBER integrated into the central receiver. The rifle must read as a long sniper rifle rather than a pistol or assault carbine. Show the complete weapon at rest beside the front view, muzzle toward the floor; three-quarter view preserves the same stock, scope, chamber and coat. Back view clearly shows her low ponytail and coat construction. Small isolated weapon detail below the figures is acceptable only if it stays separate and does not crop the boots. Accurate hands, restrained ornament, appealing character personality.
